cpu_isolation_note: Container exposes128 CPUs but cpu.max quota is14 cores; fixed nonoverlapping process masks, no affinity sweep or host exclusive-core claim.
camera_cadence: Every physics tick; measured interval0.05s, avoid independent decimal sensor interval timers
settle_scope: Fixed10s parked sensor/render warmup; no model/normal driving and no stability credit. Original40tick failures preserved. No adaptive warmup search.
additional_repeats: Only after reviewing first runs; do not repeat a scene with a system fault.
controller: Unmodified official PID methods via M8-J12 DryRunController.command; rigid ego-frame transport only between planning and control; HS checks/expiry/independent brake guard before actuation.

success.S0_S1: Route completion >=0.95 and endpoint distance <=2m, no collision/lane invasion/protection before endpoint; endpoint brake is task termination, not model stop evidence.
success.S2: Model-origin brake stops ego below0.08m/s for1s before fixed obstacle with positive OBB clearance, before any independent obstacle guard. Guard stops are failures of model stop task.
success.no_progress: After first model control, 3s stopped without S2 success ends the run as failed/no-progress.
success.timing: Wall and simulation clocks reported separately; 200ms is reference only, freshness limits never extended after results.

constraints: No automatic main update or branch deletion
